title: The MOLDS checklist
summary: A practical checklist for clearer requests and more useful answers.
body:
A small checklist I made to think more clearly before sending a complicated request to ChatGPT.

Five things to consider

Material: What information does ChatGPT need?
Outcome: What are you trying to get done?
Limits: What restrictions or requirements matter?
Done when: What would make the result good enough?
Shape: What should the final answer look like?

Not every request needs all five. “What is evaporation?” is already a clear request. The checklist is useful when the task has more moving parts.
label: PERSONAL FRAMEWORK · IN DEVELOPMENT
